ns2:course.label: Physics of Earth's Interior
ns2:course.description: Study of the state of Earth's interior, including fundamental theories, geophysical methods, and recent discoveries. Emphasizes interpretation of observed seismic and other geophysical data related to the structure, composition, evolution, and dynamical processes of the Earth's mantle and core. prerequisite: GEOL 450, GEOL 452, or consent of instructor.
